Which was your favorite part of the episode?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'll go with Kay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay! Chip, I'm really excited about seeing this movie!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But... Sniffle... Chip, I wanted to go too...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sorry, Kel... Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now let's go!
Chip and Kay head into the theater.

nodes.text: Yay! Chip, I'm really excited about seeing this movie!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sorry, Kay... Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Chip, you're going to regret this!
Chip and Kel head into the theater.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Oh just ignore her... Let's go, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Chip, you'll be sorry!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Here, take the tickets. You two should go together. You're the ones who were really excited about seeing Lisa.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I wouldn't have even won these tickets if you hadn't asked me to come.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Wow, Chip, that's really nice of you...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yeah well, you can tell me all about it after, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks, Chip! You're the best!
Kay and Kel scamper into the theater.
Chip and Kay grab the tickets and watch the movie...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: This is great!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But I wish Kel could've been here too.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, me too... But I'm still having fun.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm glad you're enjoying it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Lisa's the best!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: She seems cool.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thanks for taking me to see the movie, Chip.
Kel kisses Chip on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Kay!
Looks like things ended all right for Chip! At least he and Kay got to see the movie...
Maybe if you'd made a different choice, though, all of them could've gone!
Now let's check in with another couple this Valentine's Day...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Hey there, I saw what you did for those two girls... That was really sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey, wait a second... I've seen you on TV before... You're `Lisa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, wait a second... I've seen you on TV before... You're [color=#e23b3b][i]Lisa![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Ha ha, yes. What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm Chip.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, Chip. You know what? I have an extra ticket to this movie premiere, and you seem like a cool guy.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Want to come with?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yeah! This is awesome!
In the movie theater...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Do you think we should go back for Chip?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kel, are you feeling `guilty?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Kel, are you feeling [color=#3b78e2][i]guilty?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No way! I just... Well, he did get the tickets...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: And you guys should enjoy the movie without worrying about me.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Chip! How'd you sneak in?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I didn't need to. I came in with...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Lisa!` Can you sign my ticket for me now that you're famous?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Lisa![/i][/color] Can you sign my ticket for me now that you're famous?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Of course, girls.
Lisa signs their tickets.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks for getting us these autographed tickets, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, and for letting us see Lisa in person again!
Kay and Kel each give Chip a kiss on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: This is the best day ever!
Chip got to see Lisa `and` her new movie `A Kiss to Remember` with both twins! What a great Valentine's Day for him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Chip got to see Lisa [b]and[/b] her new movie [b]A Kiss to Remember[/b] with both twins! What a great Valentine's Day for him!

nodes.text: But let's check in with another couple this Valentine's Day...
Colt wants to give Sam a great Valentine's Day. Can you help him stay out of trouble and get Sam the perfect gift? Play as Colt to find out!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But we still didn't sneak into the movie.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What are we going to do now?

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Tickets! Free tickets for the `A Kiss to Remember` sneak preview!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tickets! Free tickets for the [color=#e23b3b][i]A Kiss to Remember[/i][/color] sneak preview!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Did you guys hear that?
They run to the front of the theater...
Where they find a stage illuminated by bright lights and blaring music from large speakers!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Do you want tickets to the new movie `A Kiss to Remember` but didn't get them in time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you want tickets to the new movie [color=#e23b3b][i]A Kiss to Remember[/i][/color] but didn't get them in time?

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, today might be your lucky day!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Win this dance competition, entertain the citizens of Centerscore, and you get free tickets!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Wait, all we have to do is dance, and we get tickets?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But we don't know how to dance...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You can win this?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: If there's one thing a Chapman can do... It's dance!
Chip steps up to the stage.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, here we have a young contestant. You have one minute to perform all your dance moves! Show the judges what you can do!
Chip takes center stage.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I just have to breakdance for the tickets... I hope I can remember all the flares and floats Spike taught me...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Collecting spiders? For what?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: For our spider collection.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story... If you were looking for spiders...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're in the wrong vent. Try the other one over there. I saw a spider as big as a badger!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Y-you did?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: They're everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Eeep! I hate spiders!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Me too! Let's get out of here!
The twins scurry back down the way they came.
Back at the ticket booth, the twins and Chip look at the `A Kiss to Remember` poster sadly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Back at the ticket booth, the twins and Chip look at the [b]A Kiss to Remember[/b] poster sadly.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, we're not in trouble...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Officer, we were just venting! It's a new extreme sport.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: It's a what?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh yeah, all the kids are doing it these days.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You climb through the vents, and it's a really great workout!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That sounds dangerous... Maybe it's better if I escort you kids out...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: No, it's okay! We can get ourselves out!
The twins and Chip tap a vent and fall through, landing safely on the ground in front of the ticket booth.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Nice seeing you, Officer Monte!
Back at the ticket booth...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That was close! Thanks for bailing me out, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm sure you guys would have come up with something...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm just glad we didn't get into trouble.
Chip hands the girls some fancy valentines.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: These are pretty... Terrible!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: These look like tablecloths! Where are the funny pictures? The jokes?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And ewwww! What's with all the hearts?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Guess I should've gone for funny.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm sure the twins will like these! And besides, you're my brother. That automatically makes your valentines cool.
Spike drops Chip off at Centerscore Elementary...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Good luck with the ladies!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanks, big bro!
In class, Chip approaches the twins...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Kay and Kel!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What's happy about it?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're not allowed to hand valentines out anymore... Not after the itching powder, electric buzzer, and the envelopes with real animal hearts...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Oh! Well, I can't do anything about that. But I do have valentines for you.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Really? Yay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Give 'em up!
As Chip and Spike leave the store...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You think they'll like the funny cards?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Of course. Look, girls dig funny guys!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The best way to a girl's heart is to make her laugh. And these cards are great.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: These `are` pretty funny...
nodes.text_bbcode: These [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] pretty funny...

nodes.text: As Chip and Spike leave the store...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You think they'll like the fancy cards?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, all girls like pretty things.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Girls like Kay and Kel?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, you may have me there, but they're still female, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what if we ate in the most romantic pirate restaurant in town?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We may have gotten lucky and found cover in the trees...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're over Linda, but...
Outside the gelato place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, Howard, I have something to tell you. I don't want you to walk me home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In fact, I don't want you to walk me home `ever again.`
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, I don't want you to walk me home [color=#3b78e2][i]ever again.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This date has been a disaster, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This one time, Centerscore accidentally got a ton of money from a volcano relief fund...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And they were offering $10,000 to the high school with the best float.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda and Kenji built this incredible float...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, `we` built this incredible float, but Alexei and his friend stole it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] built this incredible float, but Alexei and his friend stole it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So Linda came up with this great plan... I mean, `I` was part of this great plan to...
nodes.text_bbcode: So Linda came up with this great plan... I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was part of this great plan to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Why are you editing your story? I know Linda helped build the float...
$ZOE glances at Linda at the counter.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you `that` distracted by her?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] distracted by her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but... Well, forget it. Long story short, we played a lot of pranks on Wilson, we got our float back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... This feels familiar. Talking about the twins, eating gelato, you telling stories...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kind of like our first date?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Too much like our first date. Linda came in then, too, and you were distracted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've been together for three months now, and you still act the same way you did the first time we came here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just wonder if you really are over her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am! I just didn't want you to feel uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to go home, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `You` were in Boot Camp? And you tried to `escape?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] were in Boot Camp? And you tried to [color=#3b78e2][i]escape?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... When we were in a prank war with Wilson. Hector, Brendan, and I were accused of burning down the library even though we didn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! How'd you get out?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it all started with this guy named Max...
And later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And we had to fend for ourselves in the forest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I can't imagine you and the guys building a shelter in the middle of nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector was the one who navigated us through the woods and told us what we could eat out there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector? Really? I wouldn't have expected that! Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Talking about the twins, eating gelato, telling stories... This feels familiar.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's a lot like one of our first dates... The one where I realized just how lucky I was to be going out with you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, that's really sweet, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There is one difference.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda's here, and you weren't bothered by her at all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Things are different now, $ZOE. Before, she used to stir up all these emotions whenever I saw her, but now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm over it. And I'm just really happy to be with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, thanks. It's nice to hear you say that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, let's get you home.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: I deem ye...

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: True pirates!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yarr!
The Captain leads Howard and $ZOE to their table.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: And true pirates get their food. So what'll you be having then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Plank Steak please!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'll have the Hook's Choice!
As their food arrives, Howard and $ZOE eat and enjoy the next couple of hours.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry for all that hassle we had to go through trying to get seated, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry, Howard. It's not every day you get threatened by a pirate captain. It was kind of exciting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The food is great, and once you get past the marauders stalking our table, the atmosphere is pretty great too. It's nice to spend all this time with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember the first time we went to a nice restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean when we went on that double date with Jean-Paul? Where is he? I haven't seen him around lately.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's been very productively making French toast.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How very French.
And later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And remember when we had to crash a party to find Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. I had to pretend I was a Monarch Prep girl!
And finally...

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Thanks for the doubloons, mateys. You have a good evening!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That meal was delicious!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But where to now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was thinking... We should get some dessert.

nodes.text: I deem ye...

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Lily-livered codfish! And like all fish... It's best you get thrown back into the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: To the plank!
The Captain hauls Howard and $ZOE to their feet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First the rain... Now the plank?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, you can't really make us jump into the water, can you?

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: `Can't I?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Can't I?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Howard duck under the Captain and run out of the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew! That was close.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If only we'd watched 'Bucaneers of the Caribbean' before we went.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My pirate knowledge wasn't that helpful...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry for all that hassle we had to go through trying to get seated, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Howard. But what should we do now? I'm really hungry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was thinking... Maybe we could skip to dessert.
At a gelato stand down the street, Howard and $ZOE order their dessert.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This looks familiar...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's the gelato place I took you to while you were stressed out about joining the cheerleading squad...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I love this place!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One chocolate scoop in a chocolate cone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. I bet Kay and Kel would flip for a dessert like this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, that reminds me. Aren't you supposed to be watching them today?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Normally, yes, but their school is hosting a Valentine's Day party, so I don't have to baby-sit them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so relieved. You do not want to mess with the twins on Valentine's Day. You think they're scary by themselves...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Imagine them in a group of fellow fourth-graders... `With glitter.`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
Just then, Linda walks into the gelato store.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hi, Howard... And $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Funny running into you two here. Happy Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. You too.
Linda walks away.

nodes.text: This is just perfect. First the rainy picnic, then the hostile pirate captain, and now my ex-girlfriend shows up?

nodes.text: Why are you surprised?

nodes.text: Tom? What are you doing here?

nodes.text: So maybe we're not dating yet, but that doesn't mean we can't hang out as friends on Valentine's Day, right?

nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, that's sweet, but maybe this is a little too fast...

nodes.text: Oh, then you're really not going to like the surprise I planned for us...

nodes.text: Surprise?

nodes.text: A sunset walk along the beach on my family's remote island in the South Pacific...

nodes.text: The South Pacific?!

nodes.text: Too much, too fast, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I'm not letting you take me to Fiji. No matter how good that sounds.

nodes.text: But since it is Valentine's Day... If you want to grab a nice friendly lunch with me, that would be great.

nodes.text: How... Common.
